fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled OBJ face statement 'f 4 5 6 7 8' is parsed: the 1-based indices iVal are converted to 0-based and appended to the face vertex list. The 5 referenced vertices all resolve to the identical position (0,0,0), forming a degenerate polygon.

The importer creates the second aiMesh with mNumFaces=1, one aiFace of 5 indices (inp->m_vertices.size() > 3), mVertices[5] all at (0,0,0), and mPrimitiveTypes=aiPrimitiveType_POLYGON. Mesh order in the scene: mesh[0]=triangle object 'tri', mesh[1]=degenerate polygon object 'poly'.

Preprocessing recomputes/keeps mPrimitiveTypes=aiPrimitiveType_POLYGON for the polygon mesh because it has one face with mNumIndices=5 (default case). The mesh still has mNumFaces=1 here, so it is fully valid.

The first validation pass runs before post-processing: the polygon mesh has mNumFaces=1 and valid in-range indices, so 'Mesh contains no faces' is NOT reported and the scene passes validation with the polygon mesh intact (it only becomes face-less later, inside the post-processing pipeline).

aiProcess_Triangulate runs before SortByPType. The 5-vertex polygon has all-identical positions, so mapbox::earcut emits zero triangles (curOut stays == out) and the mesh is rewritten with mNumFaces=0 (empty mFaces array). mPrimitiveTypes was set to TRIANGLE by line 257.

aiProcess_FindDegenerates runs right before SortByPType. It resets mPrimitiveTypes to 0 and recomputes it from faces, but the mesh now has mNumFaces==0, so the per-face switch emits no primitive flag. With the default config (remove-degenerates off) the mesh is kept with mPrimitiveTypes==0.

While iterating the scene meshes, the single-primitive-type triangle mesh (mesh[0], mPrimitiveTypes==TRIANGLE) is moved into the local outMeshes list, but pScene->mMeshes[0] is NOT nullified. The triangle mesh is now owned by both outMeshes and the scene (ambiguous ownership).
The next mesh (the polygon mesh made face-less by Triangulate/FindDegenerates) has mPrimitiveTypes==0, so the error path is entered: 'Mesh with invalid primitive type'.

Error cleanup deletes every mesh in outMeshes - including the triangle mesh still referenced by pScene->mMeshes[0] - then throws DeadlyImportError. The triangle mesh object is freed while the scene keeps a dangling pointer to it.

ExecuteOnScene catches the DeadlyImportError thrown by SortByPTypeProcess and deletes the partially processed scene, invoking aiScene::~aiScene -> delete mMeshes[a] for the dangling triangle-mesh pointer.

aiMesh::~aiMesh runs on the already-freed triangle mesh object and reads the 8-byte mVertices pointer field at a freed address: heap-use-after-free READ of size 8, matching the OSS-Fuzz crash state aiMesh::~aiMesh / aiScene::~aiScene / Assimp::BaseProcess::ExecuteOnScene.
